questions.explanation_english: Under Section 1(4), the Act applies to every establishment in which twenty or more workmen are employed or were employed on any day of the preceding twelve months as contract labour, and to every contractor who employs twenty or more workmen. questions.explanation_english: Under Section 2(1)(a) of the Act, the Appropriate Government for any establishment carried on by or under the authority of the Central Government, or major ports, mines, railways, or banking companies, is the Central Government. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुबंध श्रम (नियमन और उन्मूलन) अधिनियम, 1970 की धारा 2(1)(क) के तहत, केंद्रीय सरकार के अधिकार के तहत संचालित किसी भी प्रतिष्ठान के लिए उचित सरकार केंद्रीय सरकार होती है। राज्य के अधिकार क्षेत्र में आने वाले अन्य सभी प्रतिष्ठानों के लिए, संबंधित राज्य सरकार उचित वैधानिक प्राधिकरण के रूप में कार्य करती है।

questions.question_english: In a Delhi Government school, the private agency supplying 25 sanitation workers refuses to provide them with drinking water, claiming they can use the students’ water points. The workers complain. As the Principal Employer, what is the Principal’s obligation under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970?
options_english: Ensure wholesome drinking water is provided, recovering costs from the agency if it defaults.
Ignore the complaint completely, treating water provision as a purely internal administrative matter of the agency.
Officially advise and instruct all complaining contract workers to bring their own drinking water from home daily.
Immediately terminate the employment of all complaining workers for committing gross workplace insubordination.
questions.explanation_english: The statutory rule prescribes option (A). As the Principal Employer, it is the responsibility to ensure that wholesome drinking water is provided to all contract workers. The Principal Employer can recover the costs from the agency if it fails to fulfill this obligation. This is essential for maintaining the health and well-being of the workers and complying with legal requirements.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। मुख्य नियोक्ता के रूप में, यह जिम्मेदारी है कि सभी अनुबंध श्रमिकों को स्वच्छ पीने का पानी प्रदान किया जाए। यदि एजेंसी इस दायित्व को पूरा करने में विफल रहती है, तो मुख्य नियोक्ता इसके खर्च की वसूली कर सकता है। यह श्रमिकों के स्वास्थ्य और कल्याण को बनाए रखने और कानूनी आवश्यकताओं का पालन करने के लिए आवश्यक है।
questions.topic: Contract Labour Abolition and Regulation Act 1970
key_facts: Principal Employers must ensure provision of drinking water.
Printed answer key: (A) Ensure wholesome drinking water is provided, recovering costs from the agency if it defaults.

questions.question_english: When the Principal Employer pays the wages because the contractor has defaulted, how can the Principal Employer recover this amount?
options_english: By filing a civil recovery suit in the jurisdictional District Court, which usually takes several years to reach final judgment.
By deducting the amount from money payable to the contractor under any contract or debt.
By making a corresponding percentage deduction from the monthly salaries and allowances of all regular direct employees.
The Principal Employer is legally barred from recovering the disbursed amount as it stands classified as a statutory default penalty.
questions.explanation_english: The Principal Employer can recover the amount paid to the workers by deducting it from any money due to the contractor under any contract or as a debt.
